{"reason":"Change the first condition to cover medium-or-higher risk, making all 35 non-low rows use guaranteed-in-time $35,000 alert-planner instead of 34 $45,000 supplier switches. This lowers train cost from $2,165,000 to $1,225,000 and removes all four stockouts, including the medium 5.3- and 2.8-day failure rows; fitness improves from -2.565 to -1.225.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
      (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
